title: Area law: Nambu-Goto action
definition: The classical string minimizes worldsheet area.

title: Polyakov action
definition: A classically equivalent form exposes worldsheet symmetries.

title: Worldsheet wave equation
definition: Left- and right-moving waves carry the string motion.

title: Open-string boundary law
definition: Endpoints obey Neumann or Dirichlet conditions.

title: Closed-string periodicity
definition: Closed-string fields repeat around the loop.

title: Tension-energy relation
definition: Longer string segments carry proportionally more energy.

title: Bosonic mass levels
definition: The intercept and factors depend on the string model and convention.

title: D-brane endpoint law
definition: Endpoints move along a brane but are fixed transversely.
